mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_task (task_no, initiator_id, status) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{initiatorId}, #{status})

INSERT INTO inventory_item (task_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, actual_version_id, actual_status, difference_type, difference_description, checked_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{expectedVersionId}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{actualVersionId}, #{actualStatus}, #{differenceType}, #{differenceDescription}, #{checkedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, archive_version_id AS expected_version_id, actual_version_id, employee_id, department_id, actual_status, difference_type, difference_description, checked_by FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_task SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
